findings.reason: a JT-60SA shot integer reaching any of these eight sites reads MAST's store rather than being refused, so §4/§7 must make the machine required (or thread the declared machine) at read_geometry_table, or state why the MAST default is safe.
findings.text: read_geometry_table declares machine: str = "mast", so the machine a shot resolves to has two owners: §7 introduces the declared per-shot-set/catalogue as the authority and states "the machine is never inferred", yet this reader infers MAST whenever the keyword is omitted; every no-machine caller in the repository therefore reads MAST's level-2 catalogue for any shot integer — imas_ambix/gs/grounding.py:473, imas_ambix/tokenizer/signal_hf_encode.py:549, imas_ambix/spine_bench/transform_geometry_source.py:325, imas_ambix/spine_bench/runner.py:273, imas_ambix/latent/data.py:421, imas_ambix/latent/data.py:457, imas_ambix/statespace/enkf_baseline.py:948, imas_ambix/statespace/enkf_baseline.py:956, and the plan's own §4 extension point

findings.reason: the plan already enumerates all three, names read_geometry_table as the single owner for the JT-60SA route and justifies leaving the MAST-only paths unchanged, so consolidation is a follow-up rather than a change to this plan.
findings.text: probe-angle supply for a geometry table has two implementations: _supply_declared_probe_angles derives angles from an acquisition-address prefix in description_reader, and _supply_probe_orientations joins them by amb_channel from the efm campaign sensor map in spine_bench; §4 enumerates both (plus the dead gs/geometry.load_tables path) and §6 adds a third sourcing (the emitted poloidal_angle) as a description branch inside read_geometry_table, so three code paths now fill the same table field

duplicate_owner-1.reason: Measured 2026-10-06: read_geometry_table(101173) and read_geometry_table(60033) at the MAST default raise LookupError (shot resolves to 0 machine maps), because MAST maps cover only 11766-30471 and map_for_shot refuses any other integer. A JT-60SA shot reaching a defaulted caller fails loudly rather than reading MAST. Making machine required would change about 60 MAST-only call sites across imas_ambix, scripts and tests with no behavioural change for this plan; a machine whose shot range overlaps MAST is the case worth guarding, and it belongs to the MAST reader owner, not the JT-60SA map.

duplicate_owner-2.reason: The three probe-angle supply paths are enumerated in the plan, which names read_geometry_table as the one owner on the JT-60SA route; the two MAST-only paths predate it, and the review judges consolidation a follow-up outside this plan.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new modules hide substantial behaviour behind interfaces smaller than what they hide: selene_deck.py exposes one entry point (write_phase_description, __all__ = ["write_phase_description"]) over three file grammars and five IDSs; eddb_remote.py hides the ssh transport, niced module-loaded remote command and framing behind one request/record pair and RemoteEddbExtractor.fetch_batch; eddb.py hides the pulse-group token, half-written-channel and refuse-to-overwrite invariants behind fetch_channels/write_channel. No spread of shallow wrappers is proposed.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — read_geometry_table keeps machine: str = "mast" as a defaulted parameter, a second owner of "which machine does this shot resolve to" beside the per-shot-set/catalogue declaration §7 introduces, and seven no-machine call sites in the repository therefore silently resolve MAST's catalogue for any shot integer.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts are public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface names what it retires, merges, or why nothing can — §2 one exporter "retires nothing, because ambix has no exporter"; §3 two modules and two refusal families (EddbRemoteError, EddbCacheError) "retire nothing, because ambix had no remote reader"; §4 the struct_array_entry slot "widens one binding contract and retires nothing" and the probe-angle key "retires the machine branch"; §5 "adds one data file and no public definition or refusal family"; §6 retires mast_angle_to_canonical and adds the measure_convention public definition, both stated; §7 the EQDB request/record pair and two record fields each "retire nothing, because no ... exists".
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the codebase it extends and cites the mechanism for nearly every proposal; I opened each named owner and each exists as described: load_packaged_signal_map/PACKAGED_MAP_ROOT (imas_ambix/data/signal_map.py:43,631), read_geometry_table (imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py:113), StoreEngine.open / _read_ids_path (imas_ambix/data/../transform_engine.py), score_convention/score_conventions/read_level2_observation (imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:329,382,490), measure_diiid_convention/_integrated_current (imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py:245,266), the eddb.py write invariants (imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:208,179), judge_geometry/read_efit_geometry/GeometryVerdict (imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py:120,174,272), MachineArtifactGeometrySource (imas_ambix/spine_bench/machine_artifact_arm.py:100) and the machine-keyed pin constants (imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:69-78). No proposal rebuilds an owner that already exists.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the additions are extensions whose extension point the plan names, not parallel layers: measure_convention subsumes the DIII-D kernel (measure_diiid_convention becomes a call to it), the pol_angle_like class joins nova's existing TRANSFORMATIONS table (verified present, keys psi_like, dodpsi_like, one_like, ip_like, q_like, b0_like) rather than a second ambix table, and the catalogue slots extend load_machine_map. The retained measure_diiid_convention entry is a caller-compatibility alias over the new kernel, which the plan states.
